method: Deep comparison against the immutable seventeen-unit baseline: every unassigned record unchanged, every old per-chapter record and earliest milestone preserved, evidence and source contracts preserved, existing surfaces identical, metadata history retained, new records equal accepted coverage.

explicit_limits: Only the 17 active contracts and actual registers establish prior teaching: 1197 lemmas, 12557 forms, 1573 senses and 1143 features.
Retain complete Exercises 44–48: 8/9/9/11/10 items, 47 in all. Their Joseph English composition sequence is not an attested Old English Joseph reading in the selected reader.

The separately assigned prose is exact Cook 175.18–177.2, PDF 191–193, 26 physical lines, ending before Apollonius as Teacher. The coordinator settled this boundary after independent image inspections.
New source-only forms, senses and whole constructions remain locally supplied with no independent recall claim.
Every response needs exact input and output dependencies and a response contract. Public task labels contain no answers.
Original note questions remain apparatus unless explicitly assigned. Note 176.13 supplies the relative antecedent; any corresponding task asks for explanation with that note visible.
No new narrative is required. Completing the final planned unit does not establish mastery of all prose, the reader, poetry or the language.
No learner or key prose precedes the coordinator’s reconciled contract checkpoint.
bounded_scope.assessment_boundary: All exact source hints and supplied forms, senses and whole constructions remain visible. Their independent recall is never assessed. A table cell establishes only its explicit morphology and stated lexical frame.
bounded_scope.source_reading: One complete226-word episode at175.18–177.2 with22 original notes and29 anchors. The subsequent Apollonius as Teacher is unassigned.
bounded_scope.completion_claim: The47 final numbered Cook items complete the canonical numbered exercise assignment crosswalk, not mastery of the entire reader, all prose, poetry or Old English.

limits: Earlier source forms supplied again receive exposure history without recognition or production milestones.
